test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: B, C, D, E, F, K and L are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. F sits second to the left of C. Only E sits between K and F. B sits third to the left of E. D is not an immediate neighbour of B. Who sits fourth to the right of L?
solution:
Given: B, C, D, E, F, K and L are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) F sits second to the left of C.

2) Only E sits between K and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11edc073cc3c3c9c6253df3f8b89e505e0e1d18906bec59855f60310d1b6e9be.png] 

3) B sits third to the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/826ac957c865e2c83a755da8ed2896ab96c20b2b4b963ecea4d87f2094ffa84e.png] 

4) D is not an immediate neighbour of B.

After positioning D only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f36c40410945362621bc40b9c2beba8531485c56200e837326d18adabd3a9311.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, D sits fourth to the right of L.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
